name: Kurumsal Ağ Topolojisi ve Güvenlik Mimarisi
summary: A cybersecurity company with an Istanbul HQ, a Sivas SOC and R&D base, an Ankara training academy and a Dubai trade office. Critical sites run Active-Passive FortiGate HA clusters with Dual-ISP SD-WAN failover, IPsec/SD-WAN tunnels terminate at the Sivas hub, remote access is enforced via role-based ZTNA/VPN with MFA, and monitoring runs in three layers with tiered log retention, automated config backups, monthly patching, active CVE watch, and KVKK/GDPR compliance.

chosen.reason: Deployed as a 2-unit FGCP Active-Passive HA cluster (<1s failover) with Dual-ISP SD-WAN. 1.5 million concurrent sessions absorb Red Team scans (Nmap/Masscan/Burp); 715 Mbps threat protection covers the 250 Mbps line.

Isolated Red Team ZTNA profile + full PCAP/Zeek logging

remoteAccess.note: Inter-branch links run over encrypted Site-to-Site IPsec VPN / SD-WAN terminating at the Sivas hub, while remote user access is scoped strictly by role (RBAC) via FortiClient ZTNA, SAML SSO, MFA, and endpoint posture verification.

monitoring.siem: Wazuh SIEM and FortiAnalyzer HA cluster in Sivas collects all four branches' firewall logs over encrypted IPsec tunnels; sFlow/NetFlow plus SPAN with Wireshark/Zeek; Sysmon and Wazuh agents on accounting, R&D, SOC, and management endpoints.
monitoring.owner: The 24/7 SOC team in Sivas (65 analysts).
monitoring.alertSink: SOC consoles in Sivas (Wazuh SIEM / FortiAnalyzer / SOAR).
monitoring.appVsSecurity: Layered: network telemetry (Layer 2) for traffic spikes and DDoS, EDR/XDR (Layer 3) for host events, firewall logs (Layer 1) for policy hits.
monitoring.retention: Tiered lifecycle: 90 days Hot NVMe indexing in Sivas (Wazuh/FortiAnalyzer) for real-time correlation, 365 days Warm compressed storage, and 2 to 5 years immutable WORM Cold archive signed with RFC 3161 timestamps per Turkish Law No. 5651 and KVKK.

operations.configBackup: Automated daily (02:00 UTC+3) and event-driven (on every policy commit) encrypted (AES-256-GCM) firewall configuration and Policy-as-Code YAML backups via FortiManager and Ansible across a 3-2-1 architecture: (1) Sivas Git/Vault server, (2) Istanbul HQ secondary DR vault, and (3) immutable off-site cloud storage. Hardware failover RTO < 1s; full site rebuild RTO < 30 min, RPO = 0.
operations.patchRoutine: Fortinet Mature (M) firmware releases and server security patches are validated in the Sivas staging lab and applied monthly on the first Sunday (02:00-05:00 UTC+3) using zero-downtime FGCP HA In-Service Upgrades. Critical zero-day vulnerabilities (CVSS >= 9.0 or CISA KEV) carry a < 24-hour emergency patch / IPS virtual-patch SLA.

cveWatch.mitigation: Upgraded all FortiGates to FortiOS 7.4.4+ / 7.2.8+ Mature builds, replaced legacy SSL-VPN with ZTNA and IPsec IKEv2, and enabled IPS virtual patching.
Upgraded to patched Mature firmware and restricted all administrative interfaces (HTTPS/SSH) exclusively to OOB Management VLAN 99 via MFA Jump Host.
Updated FortiManager to patched release, enforced serial-number certificate whitelisting, and isolated management traffic to VLAN 99.
Mature firmware baseline enforced across all 7 FortiGate units with external SSL-VPN listeners disabled.

cveWatch.component: PHP-CGI Argument Injection RCE (Web & Academy Portals)
cveWatch.mitigation: Upgraded web servers to PHP 8.3+ and deployed WAF OWASP CRS rules plus FortiGate IPS signatures in front of Ankara Academy and corporate web portals.

controls: KVKK Art. 12 & GDPR Art. 32: Strict VLAN isolation for accounting/HR and SOC segments with AES-256 IPsec / TLS 1.3 encryption in transit.
Privacy-by-Design SSL Inspection: Banking, healthcare, HR, and personal webmail categories are bypassed from Sivas SOC SSL decryption.
SIEM PII Pseudonymization: Automatic masking of Turkish ID numbers (TCKN), IBANs, and personal identifiers in Wazuh/FortiAnalyzer logs with role-restricted audit trails.
KVKK Art. 9 Cross-Border Governance: Dubai branch operational telemetry transfers over encrypted tunnels to Sivas under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC).
Law No. 5651 Compliance: Guest Wi-Fi (VLAN 70) captive portal authentication and RFC 3161 timestamped access logs archived for 2+ years.
